# Team 2 (Knowledge Graph) batch — cold review

**Reviewer:** Claude Sonnet 5, orchestrating. Generated by `qwen3.8:27b` via
`~/src/.agents/skills/assignment-forger/`, 10 tasks, ~18 minutes wall-clock
(`_batch.log`). This review reads every generated file directly against
the real corpus and the real module `ASSIGNMENT.md` — it does not trust the
model's own claims of correctness.
**Date:** 2026-09-11

## Verdict

**Promotable, after three small fixes applied in this review.** The one
defect that broke the first proof run (sibling-scope creep) did not
recur across any of the 7 full sheets — the fix held. Zero hallucinated
citations across the whole batch, verified mechanically, not by reading.

## What was checked

1. **Sibling-scope discipline** — read all 7 full sheets (tasks 1–7) against
   the full 10-item board given in every prompt. Task 1 explicitly excludes
   tag-filter/URL-state/motion ("belongs to Tasks 3 and 4"); Task 5
   explicitly declines the orphaned "animation" content found in `tasks.md`
   ("acknowledged as a separate site inconsistency... not included in this
   task's scope"). This is the exact failure mode the earlier graph-task1
   proof run made — not repeated once here.
2. **Quote citation integrity** — every cited id (`arch-001`, `a11y-001`,
   `arch-016`, `qa-019`, `ux-002`, `img-025`) checked by script against live
   `ttod.yml`: all real, all exact text matches, all genuinely present in
   the 57-quote pool supplied (not invented, not pulled from the model's
   own general knowledge). `img-025` looked suspicious on first read
   (not one I remembered seeing in the pool) — checked mechanically rather
   than trusted that impression; it was there.
3. **Shared-task discipline (items 8–10)** — all three are short
   (1.1–1.6 KB vs. 5.4–7.8 KB for full sheets), each gives a genuine
   Team-2-specific instantiation rather than duplicating the generic rule,
   and each links `tasks.md#the-three-recurring-tasks` rather than
   restating it. Followed the instruction correctly.

## Findings

**F1 (P1, fixed) — Task 6 leaked its own prompt instruction as content.**
A paragraph instructing "every mention of testing... links Unit 5... close
it here, don't reproduce the gap" appeared verbatim as a floating paragraph
in the generated file — the model echoed a piece of its own meta-instruction
rather than applying it. Fixed: removed the stray paragraph, folded the
actual Unit 5 link into the Test-shape bullet where it belonged, matching
every other task's pattern.

**F2 (P3, fixed) — Task 8 was missing its own metadata header.** Every
other task opens with a `**Seam:** ... **Team:** ... **Task:** ...` line;
Task 8 went straight from the H1 into prose. Added the missing line for
consistency.

**F3 (P2, partially fixed) — quote repetition.** `arch-001` was cited three
times (tasks 1, 8, 9) out of a 57-quote pool — clearly excessive. Fixed:
task 9 now cites `arch-051` instead (verified real, arguably a better fit
for a formal PR review than the boundary quote). Left `a11y-001`'s two uses
(tasks 2, 6) as-is on purpose: both tasks are genuinely, directly
accessibility work, and no stronger-fitting alternate existed in the
pool — forcing a weaker substitute to avoid a defensible repeat would have
been worse than the repeat itself. Judgment call, not a mechanical rule.

## What this review does not cover

- Did not verify any code-level claim by running it (e.g., that
  `filterGraph`/`selectedTag` genuinely behave as described) — that was
  already verified once, directly, when the real `graph/ASSIGNMENT.md` and
  `layout.ts` signature were read for the original proof example and this
  batch's own context. Not re-verified per-task here.
- Did not check whether `docs/public/teaching/assignments.md`'s own board
  needs the "animation" row F5 (Task 5's own note) implies is missing —
  flagged as a known, separate site inconsistency, not fixed by this batch.

## Disposition

Promoted out of `_draft-team2/` into `docs/DEV_PLAN/ASSIGNMENTS/` proper
(10 files: `ASSIGNMENT-graph-task1.md` through `task10.md`), alongside the

— that remains a separate, later, explicit step per the forger skill's own
rule.

## Addendum (2026-09-11, later) — a missed defect, caught while building the public _tasks collection

`ASSIGNMENT-graph-task10.md` was missing its required header metadata line (the same defect
class as F2/task8, above) — this review's own F2 finding did not catch it because F2 only
checked task8, not every short sheet individually. Found by a transform script that copies all
49 sheets into `docs/public/_tasks/` and defensively requires the header line to parse each
file's front matter — the script's own strictness surfaced a real, previously-promoted defect.
Fixed by hand, matching task8/9's exact header format. No other file in this batch was affected
(verified: the same script parsed the other 9 files in this batch without error).
